limitations: Nonoverlap applies only to inspected local files and fields. It does not prove global seed freshness or external-model corpus independence.
Archive members, transition/work journals, NPZ files, model weights and scientific values are not read or recomputed. Seed fields recorded only there are outside the ledger scope.

Exact-token source absence cannot resolve every computed or dynamically supplied range. The inherited known range declarations and inspected actual seed fields are complementary evidence, not an exhaustive program proof.
Duplicate ledgers and selected-row ledgers can repeat case seeds; occurrence counts are not independent episodes.
Files with no explicit seed fields do not establish nonreuse. Current study declarations reserve the proposed ranges but do not show execution.
